correctness.rationale: The weighted coordinate projections onto orthogonal lines give the invariant state map T_s=[[rho^2,-rho/s],[s rho(1-rho^2),rho^2]] with det rho^2. The two-period product has trace 2p^2-p(1-p)(q+q^{-1}) and determinant p^2, p=rho^2. The real quadratic Jury inequalities reduce to strict q+q^{-1}<(1+3p^2)/(p(1-p)); the other Schur inequality stays positive. The identity threshold=6+(3p-1)^2/[p(1-p)] yields exact uniform bound max(q,q^{-1})<3+2sqrt2, with -1 eigenmode at equality and real eigenvalue below -1 beyond. rho=0 nilpotent special case covered. Source SymPy verifier inspected; independent rational product at rho=3/5,q=6 gave det(I+P)=-4/125, an actual unstable witness.
